notes.title: Update 1.1 is coming soon!
notes.notes:
Greetings,

Update 1.1 for Alter World will be coming soon. Here's list of the changes we've made to the game:

1) Level Select - You will now be able to replay any kind of level.
2) Added Chinese localization (Both Traditional and Simplified)
3) Added Steam Controller support
4) Minor tweaks

This update will be deployed in the upcoming hours.
